purpose: Test the most direct route from the P3-overlap carrier into polynomial linear matroid parity: represent each literal occurrence by a 2-dimensional subspace and declare a witness set feasible exactly when the selected subspaces form a direct sum. The local P3 switch plus ordinary clause conflict already makes this impossible.

model.ambient: A vector space W over an arbitrary field K.
model.occurrence_representation: Each literal occurrence o is assigned a 2-dimensional subspace S_o <= W (equivalently a pair of columns spanning S_o).
model.selection_rule: A set X of occurrences is accepted iff dim(sum_{o in X} S_o)=2|X|. This is exactly independence of the union of the corresponding pairs in linear matroid parity.
model.required_pair_semantics: If two occurrences are forbidden together by the exact carrier, their subspaces must intersect nontrivially. If they are allowed together, their subspaces must intersect trivially.

local_configuration.rank3_switch: For one mixed degree-3 Boolean variable, L and R are the two majority-sign occurrences and M is the minority-sign occurrence. The exact carrier forbids LM and MR but allows LR.
local_configuration.minority_clause_alternative: Let N be any other literal occurrence in the clause containing M. The exact clause-capacity constraint forbids MN. There are normalized SAT instances in which L,R,N are simultaneously chosen as legal clause witnesses.

theorem.name: NO_EXACT_OCCURRENCE_2D_DIRECT_SUM_LIFT_FOR_P3_SWITCH_PLUS_CLAUSE
theorem.statement: No assignment of 2-dimensional subspaces can realize the exact pair semantics LM forbidden, MR forbidden, LR allowed, MN forbidden while also accepting the legal triple {L,R,N} by direct-sum independence.
proof: LR allowed implies S_L intersect S_R = {0}.
LM forbidden and MR forbidden imply A=S_M intersect S_L and B=S_M intersect S_R are nonzero subspaces.
Because S_M is 2-dimensional, A and B each contain a line. These lines are distinct: if a nonzero vector lay in both, it would lie in S_L intersect S_R, contradicting LR allowed.
Two distinct lines span the 2-dimensional space S_M. Hence S_M is contained in S_L + S_R.
MN forbidden implies S_M intersect S_N contains a nonzero vector v.
But S_M <= S_L+S_R, so v lies in S_N intersect (S_L+S_R). Therefore S_N is not disjoint from S_L+S_R.
Consequently dim(S_L+S_R+S_N) < 6, so the supposedly legal triple {L,R,N} is rejected by the direct-sum selection rule. Contradiction.
theorem.field_scope: Every field; the proof is pure dimension/intersection linear algebra and has no characteristic assumption.

explicit_sat_control.formula: C1=(x OR a OR b), C2=(x OR c OR d), C3=(NOT x OR y OR z), with fresh auxiliary variables. The assignment x=1,y=1 (and arbitrary remaining values consistent with the displayed true literals) is SAT and the witness set {L=x in C1, R=x in C2, N=y in C3} is legal, while M=NOT x in C3 conflicts with L,R by sign and with N by clause capacity.
explicit_sat_control.meaning: The contradictory local pattern is not an artificial independence table; it occurs inside an actual bounded-occurrence SAT image.

killed: One 2-dimensional linear-matroid-parity pair per literal occurrence with exact feasibility represented solely by direct-sum independence.
Any local lift in that model that encodes the P3 sign conflicts and clause capacity only through subspace intersections.
not_killed: Higher-dimensional or auxiliary subspace gadgets whose selected object is not one fixed 2D pair per occurrence.
A nonlocal linear-matroid-parity construction that changes the occurrence ground set and reconstructs witnesses globally.
Pfaffian/determinantal cancellation not expressible as direct-sum occurrence independence.

next_target.name: E8_NONLOCAL_AUGMENTATION_OR_HIGHER_LIFT_FOR_RANK3_SWITCH_V2_9
next_target.directive: Do not retry one-pair-per-occurrence linear matroid parity. Search for either (i) a nonlocal auxiliary lift whose dimension remains polynomial and whose projection exactly preserves the P3-overlap carrier, or (ii) a direct augmenting-exchange theorem on the carrier itself. Every candidate must preserve the legal L,R,N configuration above.
